purpose: 隔离黑盒验收：external contact 越阈值后通过 authority router、live validator、fake bridge 与 ACK repository；并覆盖 rest、revoke、failed ACK、restart pending。

checks.witness: real numerical threshold crossing; langchao/live authority route; live contract/boundary validation; one fake bridge commit; durable pending snapshot; terminal ACK settlement
internal rest can win numerical competition but creates no bridge call, render artifact, or pending live commit
live validator rejects revoked boundary before bridge; no pending backlog; only a separately constructed fresh round commits after re-enable
new repository instance recovers pending snapshot; failed ACK yields only censored locally observable outcomes and never confirms negative/reply/continuation

attestation.claim_limit: Pure/component-isolated acceptance only. It proves orchestration and repository contracts with in-memory doubles, not PostgreSQL concurrency, platform delivery, or model rendering.
